entries.what: Thao works her Monday night on 4 West after go-live changes, parking in the gravel overflow lot and taking the shuttle up Ortega Hill; she eats leftover rice at 2 a.m.
entries.outcome: Got through the shift with the new charting system, no major hiccups.

entries.what: Sleeps at 8:30 a.m. with blackout curtains and the box fan, then wakes at 3 p.m. and sorts out the voicemail pile.
entries.outcome: Slept about six hours; left the voicemails unheard.

entries.what: Works Tuesday night on 4 West, with Rubén's laminated sheet getting her through charting shortcuts.
entries.outcome: Charting went faster than last week.

entries.what: Before the shift she buys fish sauce and produce at Ruiz Family Market on her usual Tuesday afternoon trip.
Works Wednesday night on 4 West. Around 3 a.m., annoyed over charting corrections, she vents to Jasmine that Maribel is a hypocrite about charting and writes on her glove like it's 1995.
entries.outcome: Vented and moved on; Maribel did not hear.

entries.what: Comes home, eats toast, sleeps with earplugs and white noise against the wall noise from 209.
Off night. Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop in the afternoon and waters the pothos and basil on the balcony.
Makes a thermos of cà phê sữa đá and packs rice for tomorrow while rewatching her baking show.
Ignores a 1 p.m. call from Hạnh and lets another Vietnamese voicemail go to the pile.
Off day with errands: loads her laundry card at the Marisol Gardens laundry room and does a wash.
Texts Linh to check how anatomy is going and asks if she's eaten lunch.
entries.outcome: Linh says fine; Thao doubts it.

entries.what: Saturday night shift, preceded by a nap. Hears the baby through the wall from 209 all afternoon.
Feeling for the exhausted neighbors in 209, she asks the assistant how to make a white-noise and soothing playlist to share with Elliot and Hana.
entries.outcome: Built a playlist and planned to send the link to Elliot.

entries.what: Works the Saturday night on 4 West.
After shift, eats phở tái at Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine.
Sleeps mid-day, then skips the farmers market at Delgado Park and sends Elliot the playlist link.
Sunday evening, family dinner at Hạnh's Pell Road house this week.
entries.outcome: Hạnh grilled Linh about pharmacy; Thao steered the talk elsewhere.
